Add FieldRenamer(mapping,conflict="error"/"keep"/"overwrite") processor in structlog.processors. Freeze string mapping, reject duplicate destinations, ignore absent sources, apply all moves from original snapshot so swaps/chains work. Default external destination collision raises before any mutation; keep retains conflicting source/destination and transitively prevents moves into newly retained fields; overwrite explicitly replaces destination. Return independent outer dict preserving payload identity and untouched source; existing EventRenamer unchanged.

Add EventProjector(fields,keep=(),missing="error"/"omit"/"default",default=None). Explicit output-alias to tuple/list path segments, str dict keys and nonnegative int list indexes, no implicit dotted-path interpretation or Python attribute access. Only retain requested top-level fields plus projections; reject alias/keep collision and invalid paths before processing. Actual None is present, missing paths follow explicit policy. Return new outer event preserving payload identity and source; do not infer entire schema or expand object tree.

Add ZonedTimeStamper(zone,*,timespec="microseconds",key="timestamp",clock=None) processor in structlog.processors. Accept tzinfo or standard ZoneInfo name, convert an actual aware datetime instant with astimezone, output ISO offset with selected supported precision, mutate/return same event.
